The U.S. Election Assistance Commission welcomes any general comments the jurisdiction may wish to share regarding its Election Day experiences (e.g., problems with voting system anomalies*, recounts, staffing, challenges to eligibility, long lines, etc.), or note-worthy success in administering the November 2012 general election.

Please feel free to attach additional pages as necessary. * An anomaly is defined as an irregular or inconsistent action or response from the voting system or system component resulting in some disruption to the election process.
